_readme: User-visible changes in the replacement app, newest first.

entries.summary: Home: lighter page behind black panels; centred titles on phones; icons in the top-left corner
detail: Dark theme: the home page background is slightly lighter (#15171b) and the Learn/Practise panels are pure black, so the panels stand out.
Learn and Practise titles are centred on phones too; the folded row's numbers are centred under them.
The leaf and clock icons sit in each panel's top-left corner (desktop and phones); the fold arrow is in the top-right.

entries.summary: Desktop: Learn and Practise titles are centred headings over their own rule
detail: On desktop each section's title is centred with a divider line beneath it, so the two panels read as equal and separate. Phones are unchanged.

entries.summary: Learn sheet: same yellow as the progress bar; estimate box moved above the legend
detail: Seen/Known/Estimated/Skipped colours are now defined once for the whole home screen, so the Learn sheet and the folded Learn row match the bar and the level-progress sheet.
"Not sure where to start?" now sits above "Your progress bar" in the Learn sheet.

entries.summary: Learn and Practise buttons: bigger action word, quieter time limit and count
detail: The action word on the Learn and Practise buttons is 20% larger and the buttons are taller.
The time limit chip and the card count (e.g. "20 new") are regular weight rather than bold.

entries.summary: Practise sheets lose their double titles; ? icons; Learn sheet refreshed; bigger Practice page on desktop
detail: Removed the extra "Practise" label above the scheduling sheet and "Known · Practice · New" above the Practice sheet.
The Practice sheet is much larger on desktop (rows, counts, word lists, titles).
Learn and Practise help buttons are now a question mark, the same size as the title.
Learn sheet: Smart Skip note, then a progress-bar legend using the bar's own colours; Estimated shows only once you have done a level estimate.

entries.summary: iCloud email warning is now a blocking dialog; Practise (i) opens the spaced-repetition explainer
detail: Pressing Continue with an @icloud.com, @me.com or @mac.com address stops and shows a dialog that must be dismissed (Use another email); nothing is sent.
The (i) beside Practise on the home screen now opens the "How Practise is scheduled" sheet, which says whether spaced repetition is on or off. The old Practise info sheet is gone.

entries.summary: Phones: Learn and Practise titles stay put; the open section gets an accent edge
detail: The icon and name of a folded Learn/Practise row now sit at exactly the same spot as in the open header, so nothing shifts when you swap sections.
The section you are in has a thin accent-coloured left edge and a tinted border.

entries.summary: Sign-in page trimmed: no subtitle, no About link, iCloud warning only for iCloud addresses
detail: Removed "Sign in to save your learning across devices".
Removed "About this project" from the sign-in/sign-up page (still in Settings).
The email-codes warning now appears only after typing an @icloud.com, @me.com or @mac.com address.

entries.summary: Home: folded Learn/Practise rows match the open headers; bigger text on desktop; new Learn info sheet
detail: Phones: the folded section shows its icon, name and (i) button like the open header, with its numbers underneath. The (i) opens the info sheet without unfolding.
Desktop: home text 18px to 21px (23px from 1440px wide); section titles and level numbers scaled up to match.
The level info sheet is now titled Learn: pick a level, Smart Skip, and what New / Seen / Known / Estimated mean.

entries.summary: Plural nouns now say "from" their singular on the back of the card
detail: The top sense row of a plural noun (olas, casas) reads "from ola" / "from casa", as verbs already did (fue from ir).
Dropped-letter forms such as vamo' still don't repeat the lemma.

entries.summary: Pins only show for some meanings; clearer practise pill; plural glosses no longer doubled
detail: A card with every meaning marked after a miss now comes back whole, with no pins; pins and the pill appear once only some meanings are pinned.
The front pill reads "2 of 4 meanings to practise" in larger, bolder text.
A plural noun whose English gloss is already plural (plans, cops, mountains) is no longer pluralised again ("planses").

entries.summary: Practise: what comes back later shows only once you're caught up
detail: While words are waiting, Practise lists just Mistakes and Due for review; the "Coming back …" row (and the later-this-week rows added an hour earlier) are gone, as is "back within …" from the folded summary.
When nothing is waiting, "All caught up" still says what comes back next and how many more this week.

entries.summary: Home: Learn opens first; Practise shows what is coming later
detail: Phones and tablets: Learn is always the card open on arrival, with Practise folded under it. It used to open Practise first once 5 or more mistakes were waiting.
Practise now lists the whole outlook under the next batch: "Later this week" and "After this week", as well as "Coming back …".

entries.summary: Progress: Import known words and Export mistakes at the foot of the page
detail: The same two actions as Settings → Your words, under the counts they affect. Import shows only when signed in and opens the import screen; Export downloads the CSV and reports here.
Side by side on wider screens, stacked rows on phones. Settings → Your words keeps them too.

entries.summary: Fix: Conjugations never loaded on the live site
detail: The embedded verb drill loaded its scripts from the site root (/conjugation/…). Production lives under /Fluency-App/, so every script 404'd and the drill sat on "0 cards". Scripts now load from the app's own folder; staging was unaffected because it is served from the root.
The address the drill puts in the bar no longer has a double slash (/Fluency-App//conjugation), which also sent its data requests to the wrong place.

entries.summary: Desktop sidebar: a chip turns into its choices in place
detail: Pressing Vocabulary, Music or Artist in the sidebar no longer keeps the chip and opens a menu repeating it underneath. The chip is replaced by the choices themselves, the current one ticked; clicking elsewhere or Escape brings the chip back.
The truncated one-line descriptions under Speech/Music and Artists/Spotify playlists are gone.

entries.summary: Choose what to learn from: two Best for points per card on phones
detail: Phones drop "Following films and TV" (the intro names films and TV) and "Studying your own playlists" (the Spotify footer covers it). Tablet and desktop keep all three.

entries.summary: Music's Best for reads as activities, like Speech's
detail: "Songs by artists you love" and "Your own playlists" become "Understanding your favourite songs" and "Studying your own playlists", matching "Starting from scratch" and "Following films and TV".

entries.summary: Choose what to learn from: clearer intro, icons beside titles, fuller Best for, balanced cards
detail: Title is now "Choose what to learn from". The intro says what happens: words are counted in films and TV or in songs and taught as flashcards, most common first; progress is shared between the two.
Each card has its icon beside its name and three Best for points; the one-line description inside the cards is gone (the intro covers it), as is the footnote under them.
Side by side (tablet and desktop), Speech has a footer, "From real film and TV subtitles" with a yellow film icon, to match Music's Spotify footer. Phones do not show it.

entries.summary: Home: seedling and clock icons for Learn and Practise; larger titles on desktop
detail: Learn has a white seedling and Practise a white history clock, by the names on both the open cards and the folded rows.
On desktop the two names are larger (24–34px) with a little more room above, using the spare height.
Choose your vocabulary: "You can switch between Speech and Music any time" is left-aligned with the title and intro.

entries.summary: Practise info: one title; clearer Due for review line
detail: The Practise information sheet had a small "Practice" label above its "Practise" title; only the title is left.
Due for review now reads "Words recently correct, scheduled for spaced repetition."

entries.summary: Home: the folded Learn or Practise card keeps a short version; desktop example words sit above the level bar
detail: Phones and tablets: the closed card is no longer a single line. Folded Learn shows its level and words, the level bar and its counts; folded Practise shows the total and a line of mistakes, due and coming back. Tapping it opens it, and the button at the bottom follows whichever card is open.
Desktop: the level's example words moved from under the level number to the right-hand column, above the bar, which makes the Learn card shorter.

entries.summary: Function-word examples: only the parts the pattern names are coloured
detail: Where a pattern was shortened (e.g. "think + que" no longer names the clause after it), that part of the example sentence is now plain text instead of keeping its colour.
Applies to 109 slots across the 115 Spanish and Portuguese patterns; the fix is in the generator template too, so re-syncing keeps it.

entries.summary: Function-word cards: active pattern marked by a part-of-speech bar on its left edge
detail: Replaces the full coloured outline and tint: the active pattern now has a neutral lift and a 3px bar in its part-of-speech colour on the left.
The function word itself stays white in the patterns and the example, over its part-of-speech underline, even where the pattern writes its colour inline.

entries.summary: Black palette on startup, sign-in and end of session; function-word cards match ordinary cards
detail: The loading screen, Welcome back, sign-in and the end-of-session card now use the black page and near-black cards. The end-of-session card is no longer tinted with the accent.
The rail down the left of a part of speech's sense rows is slightly thinner (1.5px) when the active sense is elsewhere.
Function-word cards: the active pattern has the same part-of-speech outline as an active sense row. The word itself stays white with a part-of-speech underline, in the patterns and in the example.

entries.summary: Fix: on desktop the main menu stayed on top when starting a study session
detail: The desktop home layout forced the setup panel to show with !important unless it had an inline display:none, which also beat the .hidden class the app adds when a session starts. The panel now steps aside for .hidden.
The same guard is on every other forced display rule in home-layout.css (Learn, Practise, the level body).

entries.summary: Choose your vocabulary: new opening line; Speech and Music headings line up
detail: Opening line: 'This app teaches the most common words first. What’s common depends on where the words come from.'

On desktop the Speech and Music icons and titles sit at the same height: both cards start their content at the top and use the same padding (Music's button had 18px against Speech's 26px). Spotify stays as the Music card's footer.

entries.summary: Desktop home: Learn and Practise both open and only as tall as their content
detail: With the sidebar showing, Learn and Practise are both open, Learn above Practise; the fold rows are hidden.

Cards no longer stretch to the window's height; vertical padding is fixed and smaller, and the big numbers top out at 60px. In a 1440x900 window Learn is ~290px and Practise ~320px, so both fit with room to spare.
Width is unchanged. Phones still show one card at a time.

entries.summary: Choose your vocabulary: two equal cards, one intro line, no 'or'
detail: Speech and Music are two equal cards: icon, name, one sentence, Best for. Stacked on phones (icon, name and › on one row); side by side filling the width on desktop.
The three intro bullets are one line: 'Common words first. What’s common depends on where the words come from.'
Removed the 'or' divider and the 'Choose another language' button (the top bar and sidebar already switch language).
Shorter copy, also used by the pop-up picker and tutorial: 'Words and examples from films and TV.', Best for 'Everyday conversations', 'Your favourite artists', 'Learning by listening'.
Spotify is a flat footer on the Music card.

entries.summary: Top bar: language chip has no outline
detail: On phones and narrow windows the flag and language name sit in the bar with no pill outline; it is still the same button.

entries.summary: Black palette on flashcards (dark theme)
detail: The study screen uses the same black page and near-black card as Smart Skip and the home screen.

Panels that had blue-grey typed in now follow it: example sentences, phrase examples, and the function-word sentence panel and parts box. Pop-ups from the card (card info, word forms, frequency, sense detail, direction, lookup) use one lighter step.
Part-of-speech tints (e.g. the blue on noun meanings) are unchanged.
The palette now lives in css/black-palette.css, which lists the screens using it: home and flashcards so far (Smart Skip keeps its own trial copy). Light theme is untouched.

entries.summary: Home: bigger text, white New dot, clock back on the time button, centred Learn label
detail: Shared text size up one step: 16px on phones, 18px from 1024px; section titles 20px.
New is white in the level bar and its legend again.
The clock icon is back on the 5 min button.
On phones, 'Learn · 20 new' / 'Practise · N' is centred on the whole bar rather than on the part right of the time.

entries.summary: Home: black page with near-black cards, one text size, flat bottom bar
detail: Dark theme on the home screen uses the Smart Skip page's palette: a black page (#000), cards just lifted off it (#0d0e10), #24272b borders.
One text size for everything that isn't a heading or a headline number: 15px on phones, 17px from 1024px wide (as on Smart Skip). The tiny 12-14px labels are gone.

Phone bottom bar is flat: same black as the page with a line above it, no rounded box or shadow, and less padding underneath. On wider screens the card footer is no longer a separately shaded box either.
Smart Skip line ends in › instead of the word Details so it fits on one line at the larger size; the whole line still opens Smart Skip's page.

entries.summary: Phones: the start button is a bar across the bottom of the screen
detail: Under 768px wide, the open card's footer (Smart Skip + 'Learn · N new', or 'Practise · N') is a full-width bar fixed to the bottom of the screen, whichever card is open.
The page leaves room underneath so the last card never sits behind the bar. Desktop is unchanged.

entries.summary: Home on desktop fills the window instead of a narrow 560px column
detail: From 1024px wide: the column takes the full width beside the sidebar and the open card stretches to the bottom of the window, with its button at the bottom of the card.
Learn: level picker and example words on the left, the level's progress bar and counts on the right. Practise: the total on the left, Mistakes / Due / Coming back on the right.
Headline numbers, labels and the button scale with the window size rather than using fixed pixel sizes. Phones are unchanged.

entries.summary: Home screen: Learn and Practise fold into each other; one button each, plainer top bar
detail: 'Choose a level' is now 'Learn'. Learn and Practise are two cards and only one is open; the closed one is a single row (e.g. 'Practise · 12 waiting · 7 mistakes'). Tap it to swap.

Practise opens first when 5 or more mistakes are waiting, until you pick a card yourself this visit. Practise is language-wide: it lists Mistakes, Due for review and what comes back next, with 'Practise · N' at the bottom.
Level picker is ‹ Level N › with its word range (swipe on phones). The segmented scrubber and the 'Your progress' coverage bar are gone from this screen.
One bar for the chosen level: New, Seen, Known, Estimated, Skipped. 'Practice' in the level counts is now 'Seen', since Practise is no longer per level.
Smart Skip is one line above the button: 'Smart Skip · fewer cards · Details' with a switch; when on it shows how many fewer cards. The button reads 'Learn · 20 new'.
Desktop: one centred column, no empty right-hand column at 1280px and wider. Phones: the open card's footer stays at the bottom of the screen.
Top bar on phones and narrow windows: no filled, ringed rectangle; an outlined language chip and a thin line in the language's colours underneath.
Fix: after turning Smart Skip on, its invisible animation backdrop stayed over the page and blocked every tap.

entries.summary: Smart Skip: app nav reaches the bottom with Bigger text on; More rules lines up with the rule cards
detail: With Bigger text on, Smart Skip turns the page zoom off on desktop, but the left nav still divided its height by 1.15 and stopped 117px short of the bottom (783px of 900). The zoom variable is now reset with it.
The More rules row and its unfolded rules line up with the text and switches inside the rule cards above.

entries.summary: Smart Skip desktop: no divider, wider sidebar, closer columns, larger text
detail: Removed the vertical line between the rules sidebar and the word list, and brought the two columns closer together.
Wider sidebar (up to 480px) and larger text on desktop: 19px for everything, 28px title; 17px on narrower desktops under 1280px.
Category chips wrap on desktop instead of scrolling; the row arrow has its own space so it no longer overlaps Rank; rule names wrap instead of being cut short.

entries.summary: Smart Skip: one text size, near-black surfaces (trial), and Compare with lists only usable languages
detail: Every piece of text on the Smart Skip page is one size (17px on desktop, 15px on a phone); only the page title and sheet titles are larger. Weight and colour carry the hierarchy.
Trial, Smart Skip page only, dark theme: rule cards, the word list, chips and sheets use near-black surfaces (#0d0e10) instead of the slate blue-grey.
Compare with shows only known languages this deck has look-alike data for; a known language without data no longer appears as a chip that does nothing.
